title: Cutoff via rigidity for curved diffusions
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of Chafaï and Fathi, "On cutoff via rigidity for high dimensional curved diffusions" (Comptes Rendus Mathématique 363 (2025) 1103-1121), in the corrected version arXiv:2412.15969v5. The submitted statement surface PalomarChallenge.lean (Comparator configuration comparator-palomar.json) states the theorems and corollaries of the paper (Theorems 1.1, 1.5, 1.7, 1.9, 3.1, 3.6, Corollaries 1.3, 1.4, 1.6): 9 theorems. The repository also contains a larger surface, Challenge.lean with comparator.json (69 theorems: remarks, examples and Section 4 as well). Both are proved with the standard axioms only. Some statements are restricted or amended; every difference with arXiv v5 is listed in fidelity.divergences.
